comment: The inputs and outputs carry whatever you patch in, audio or control voltage, so they are given no family. The panel marks the input column with the maker's normalling arrow, and the code cascades: normalVoltage carries the previous channel's value forward each iteration, starting at 0V. The two switches on each channel are polarity switches printed +|- on the panel; the white one inverts the input and the orange one inverts the offset. The level knob's tooltip flips sign with the input polarity switch (displayMultiplier at src/Asset.cpp:57-58), as does the offset knob's.
